selection_rule: eligible = deployed bytes <= 5120 and every one of 10 repeat means (each = mean of 5 fold accuracies) >= 0.9; winner = smallest deployed footprint among eligible, ties -> higher overall mean; family representative by same rule within family, else highest overall mean; sd is ddof=1 over repeat means

headline.note: broad-resampling estimates use the set-aside recordings and are NOT selection-free
headline.holdout_caveat: the set-aside recordings were part of the evidence that drove the switch from rf_n20_d4 to dt_d3; the fixed holdout is supporting evidence, NOT an untouched holdout estimate

deployed_model.trained_on: all 150 recordings (6000 windows), 18 features, same config and random_state as the selected config
deployed_model.accuracy_estimate: no untouched evaluation data exists for this model; its accuracy estimate is the broad-resampling estimate of the training procedure (re-draws 0.9315, all-data CV 0.9315); Phase 6 hardware data is its real test
deployed_model.scope_note: the fixed-holdout metrics, family-representative metrics and the offset test describe the dev-trained model (120 recordings), not this model
deployed_model.alternatives: see models/selected/comparison.md for the 24-config comparison and the documented fallback rf_n50_d4

broad_resampling.note: uses all 150 recordings including the 30 set-aside holdout recordings; computed after selection; NOT selection-free
broad_resampling.redraw: 200 holdout re-draws: per seed (42+5000+i) draw 10 recordings/class from all 50 as test, train on remaining 40/class; RF by hard vote
broad_resampling.cv_all_data: 40 repeats (seed 42+6000+i) of grouped stratified 5-fold over all 150 recordings, 10 recordings/class per test fold; repeat value = mean of 5 fold accuracies

selection_history.reason_for_change: single-assignment luck (dt_d3 missed 0.90 at 0.8975 only on that one fold assignment) and az_rms offset fragility (24-feature trees split on DC-dominated az_rms; rms dropped)

selection_history.rule: highest mean among configs <= 5120 B with all repeat means >= 0.9
selection_history.reason_for_change: the RF dev-CV lead did not survive broad resampling (rf_n20_d4 0.9249 vs dt_d3 0.9315 over 200 re-draws; 0.9270 vs 0.9315 over 40 all-data CV repeats; dt_d3 >= rf_n20_d4 in 75% of CV repeats; fixed holdout 0.9042 vs 0.9383); RF hard-vote ties break toward normal by the lowest-index rule; rf_n20_d4 is 33x the size

selection_history.rule: smallest deployed footprint among configs <= 5120 B with all repeat means >= 0.9; ties -> higher mean
deployment: same config retrained on all 150 recordings

previous_winner_tie_note: rf_n20_d4 hard-vote ties on the fixed holdout: 8 of 1200 windows; true classes of tied windows {'normal': 0, 'abnormal': 8, 'faulty': 0}, predicted {'normal': 6, 'abnormal': 2, 'faulty': 0} (lowest-index tie rule breaks toward normal).
offset_scope: The offset test shows the 18 mean-removed features are invariant to constant per-axis offsets BY CONSTRUCTION. It does NOT test axis rotation / mounting orientation changes, sensitivity/gain (scale) errors, or temperature drift; these are open questions for Phase 6 hardware validation.
oof_note: family representative OOF metrics pool out-of-fold predictions from all repeats

formulas.tree: bytes = 10 * node_count (feature idx u8 + threshold f32 + left int16 + right int16 + class/leaf u8); int16-threshold variant = 8 * node_count; forest = sum over trees; ops = sum of max tree depths
formulas.mlp: int8_bytes = weights*1 + biases*4 + layers*4 (one f32 scale per layer) + n_features*8 (scaler mean+scale f32); ops = MAC count = weights
formulas.forest_inference: one class per leaf, hard majority vote, ties -> lowest class index (all forest accuracies use this); single tree: leaf class

band_energy_note: not needed: at least one config eligible with 18 features

offset_test.description: per-recording constant offset U(-1000,1000) counts on all 6 axes added to holdout raw windows, clipped to int16, features recomputed; 10 seeded draws (seed 42+1000+d); deterministic worst case az -1000 / +1000
